messages:
maria_support: FYI — Zephyrus Labs procurement just replied. They state we cannot send an official invoice until they provide an 'Official Order Authorization' (signed) or a PO number from their ERP. They asked us to hold all invoices until that arrives.
ethan_sales: ugh, thanks for the heads up. do we have the exact wording they sent? can we ask for a PO number only (faster) or do they insist on the letter?
maria_support: pasted the customer note below (redacted):
> "Per our procurement policy, invoices will not be processed without an official Purchase Order number OR a signed Order Authorization Letter from our finance team. Please hold billing until we share either document."
jessica_finance: noted. we can't generate a tax invoice without their PO per contract? what does the SOW say about billing triggers?
ekai_csm: contract section 3.2 says 'billing upon delivery, subject to customer purchase order policies.' cc'ing sales.
ethan_sales: i'll ping our contact, but their procurement usually sends the PO within a week. can we offer a proforma invoice in the meantime so they can start approvals?
jessica_finance: we can do a proforma but it must be clearly marked "PROFORMA — not a tax invoice" and we shouldn't recognize revenue until official invoice is issued. also watch VAT flags if they need a tax invoice.
maria_support: customer asked specifically: "Can Redwood issue a proforma or hold until PO arrives?" they prefer hold but want visibility into costs.
jessica_finance: proposed next steps: 1) Offer proforma PDF with estimated amounts + payment link (if they want to pay early). 2) If they refuse, wait for their PO and then issue official invoice. 3) If PO will be delayed beyond 10 business days, escalate to AM for credit hold decision.
billing_bot: Invoice hold flag set: reason="awaiting_customer_PO" set_by=maria_support timestamp=1736450800
ethan_sales: sending short note to procurement contact now: "Hi — we can provide a proforma for approvals. If you prefer we hold, please share expected PO ETA so we can coordinate." will update here. :phone: 
maria_support: thanks. can finance prep the proforma template so i can attach it? quick fields: items, qty, est tokens, est total, billing address, tax/VAT note.
jessica_finance: prepping template now. include invoice terms: net30, Redwood tax ID, and a clear VAT line. i'll drop the PDF here when ready.
ekai_csm: if they need a signed authorization letter, sales should confirm who signs (procurement or CFO) so we don't get a mismatched doc.
ethan_sales: good call. i'll ask. will update by EOD. :thumbsup: 
maria_support: perfect. leaving the invoice on hold until we get either PO or signed authorization. thx all.
(edited)
